description: 从极普通的事物里发现意义——不是因为它特别，而是因为你换了角度
core_questions: 这个平凡之物，正在发生什么？
如果换一个人来看，他会注意到什么？
这件事每天都在发生，为什么今天才看见？
bad_output_patterns: treats the ordinary as poetic without explaining why
good_output_patterns: reveals something unexpected inside the ordinary
shows the ordinary thing doing something the reader had not noticed
turns a mundane fact into a discovery about how things work
changes how the reader sees something they look at every day
